profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at FIS Worldpay
profile.summary:
Principal Software Engineer with over 30 years of software development experience. Skilled problem-solver with a proven ability to communicate with business and technical stake-holders. Motivated, self-directed, detail-oriented engineer with a strong desire to learn, personally contribute, and mentor others.
Experienced in software development using: 
Java; C/C++; SQL/Relational Databases; Unix Scripting
Oracle; Sybase; Informix; MySQL; Derby; PostgreSQL
Eclipse IDE; RCP; EMF; NetBeans;JProfiler; Charles
Git; SourceTree; SVN; ClearCase; CVS
Agile; Jira; Confuence
Maven; ant; make; Jenkins; Kubernetes; Docker
Experienced in the development of: 
Service Oriented Architecture (SOA)/Web Services (SOAP/REST)
Relational Databases (Design and Normalization) & Data Models (UML)
Client-Server Applications (sockets/SSL/CAs)
Data Management Applications (SQL/JDBC/JPA)
Machine Learning Algorithm
Experience using the following technologies: 
WebLogic; WebSphere; JBoss; Glassfish; Apache; Tomcat 
Java EE; JSP; JavaScript ;WSDL; Axis;
XML; SAX; DOM; JAXP; HTML; JSP; JSF; Struts; Swing; JPA; Hibernate; Spring
OSGi; Equinox; Karaf; Blueprint; UNIX; C/C++; C++ STL; Rogue Wave

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Enhanced and supported a business-to-business payments system written primarily in C++.

As Architect, Scrum Master and Lead Developer, formed a small team to develop Predictive Analytics Microservices in Java, exposed as Web Services. Tools included Eclipse, Bitbucket, Jira, Confluence, Charles, Oxygen, Jenkins, JUnit, shell scripts, Swagger and SoapUI.

Developed a (Predictive Analytics) Sanctions Screening Service capable of searching multiple sanctions lists in real time (in the transaction processing stream). Web Services were deployed to various application servers including Tomcat and WebLogic. I designed the backing and operational database which was deployed to various RDBs including MySQL, PostgreSQL and Oracle using Liquibase scripts.

Partnered with the chief data scientist to implement a proprietary rule-based Machine Learning algorithm based on thresholding of precision, recall and f-scores of subsets defined by rules. Integrated the algorithm into a larger Machine Learning solution using Kubernetes and Docker.  

Optimized cpu, memory and persistent storage using JProfiler to identify excessive memory usage, excessive garbage collector activity and cpu hot spots.  

Developed a data store microservice backed by the native file system. Relational database operations proved too slow for the algorithm, so the file system was chosen as the data store. File streams proved too slow for many operations so Memory Mapped Files were used to provide fast random access.  

Developed a task management microservice capable of managing the execution of tens of thousands of interdependent tasks efficiently using a fixed thread pool. The hierarchical nature of the algorithm lead to much parallelization and reuse of calculations. Standard multi-threading solutions quickly resulted in thread exhaustion. To efficiently use threads, the algorithm was structured into a graph of  interdependent tasks.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Implemented Java / Spring Web Services using a custom context-aware (user, locale and web-site) service framework, for a client-facing application to maintain data describing dynamic ECommerce web pages. Tools included Eclipse, Git, Maven, Ivy, Ant, Jenkins, JUnit, Mockito , Powermock, Jira and Greenhopper.

Implemented a service framework for exposing business objects in Web Services with minimal coding. Substantial use of custom annotations and reflection allowed the framework to provide high JUnit test coverage with little coding.

Researched and created PoCs for the possible move of our product to OSGI. I identified some major obstacles and outlined a migration strategy for overcoming them.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
--Equity Investment--
Enhanced an Eclipse RCP application providing fund managers and traders with the ability to create orders for securities in the funds which they manage. Updated the EMF model and views to support editing data objects accessed through continuous queries to the underlying RTE (real time) database. Tools included Spring, Clear Case, Maven, Hudson, Crucible, Check Style, JUnit, EasyMock, Clover. Project management was Agile with Result Space and Quality Center.

Designed and developed the data model and web services to support the application, using a pre-existing custom framework on top of JMS. The service layer had to implement an API designed to support the next generation of trading engine while interfacing with the legacy database. This challenging task required the business logic to be interleaved with the existing legacy functionality so that, when the new trading engine is ready, the GUI can seamlessly switch from the legacy database to the new trading engine.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
--HR Services (Mid-Market SaaS)--
While embedded with BAs, created Data Entity Model and Activity Diagrams in UML using StarUML. Built POCs using NetBeans 6.5 (Java EE 5) to assess viability of use for the WS development.

--Risk Management--
Developed Web Services using RAD7 (for WebSphere 6.1) to support an  Adobe Flex RIA. Defined multi-port/multi-operation services in WSDL. Generated and developed Web Services from the WSDL definition. 

Developed data access packages using the DAO pattern to access the underlying data via other web services, xml services and JDBC (DB2 and Oracle). Developed filters for logging and authorization. Required the creation and approval of System Design Specs (SDS) and Technical System Design (TSD) specs. Implemented unit and system tests.

Updated Adobe Flex application and supporting Web Services in subsequent product phase. Required the creation and approval of SDS and TSD.

Developed and updated C/C++ and Java apps and supporting UNIX scripts.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
--Life Insurance--
Developed web services for WebSphere using WSAD, for Visual C++ applications and batch processes. Services accessed external web services implementing two-way SSL; provided full validation; stored all transactions to Sybase.
Implemented updates to Visual C++ applications.
Lead a team to design, develop and implement a CM strategy for all products produced by the group.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
--Brokerage - Document Management--
Developed asynchronous back-end to store and index documents to FileNET and Informix, using C++ and Java. Designed and developed the database, processes and C++ class libraries.
Developed web services for Tomcat/Apache to support document submission.
Rearchitected system to replace Informix with DB2 and Oracle; replace Tomcat/Apache with WebSphere; replace C++ with Java; and provide enhancements.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
--Disability Insurance--
Developed back-end processes supporting claims processing and 4D applications, using C/C++ and Sybase on AIX. Developed interfaces to the Federal Reserve (ACH), IRS, SSA and other state agencies.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Participated in the development of client/server software for operations and real-time systems. Designed and developed a corporate billing system. Responsibilities included research and analysis; creation of reliability studies and software specifications; design and implementation of applications written in assembler, C, OCI, Pro*C, SQL and Powerbuilder on Windows, VMS and Unix hosts.

positions.title: Sr. Opto-Mechanical Designer
positions.description: Participated in all phases of product development of precision opto-mechanical instruments including design, documentation and construction.  Responsibilities including leading teams of sizes varying from 3 to 10 draftsmen; building and refining prototypes; planning and expediting the manufacture and assembly of the instruments; and introduction and turnover to production.
